body_markdown:
When you search for construction and home services jobs, you need more than a list of open roles. The job has to match your schedule, requirements, location, pay expectations, and the way you actually want to work.


Sorce is building industry-specific job search flows so contractors, installers, skilled laborers, and home service workers can find better-fit opportunities faster. Instead of repeating the same search across job boards, you can build a profile once, swipe on roles that fit, and let Sorce help with the application flow.


## Why this job search matters


Construction and home services was large because of a concentrated pool-installation campaign, but the search intent is clear: people want skilled contractor work with strong earning potential.


That is why this search should be specific. A plain list of jobs is not enough; you need to know what to compare and what information improves the match.


## What to compare before applying


For construction and home services roles, compare:


- contractor vs employee status
- tools, vehicle, and insurance requirements
- travel territory
- seasonality
- pay timing and job volume


The best role is not always the one with the highest headline pay. A job with better schedule fit, clearer requirements, stronger benefits, or a shorter commute may be the better move.


## What to add to your Sorce profile


A stronger profile helps Sorce filter toward roles that make sense. For construction and home services jobs, include:


- trade skills
- crew size
- vehicle and tools
- service area
- contractor experience


This is especially important in construction & home services because employers often use specific requirements that do not show up in the title alone.


## How Sorce helps


Sorce gives job seekers a faster loop: set your preferences, swipe on jobs you would actually consider, and let the AI agent help submit applications. You get 40 free swipes per day, and the goal is better-fit applications instead of more noise.


Use Sorce when you want to compare opportunities by fit: schedule, pay structure, required experience, benefits, commute, and the kind of work you want to do next.
